profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at FortyAU
profile.summary: Seasoned software consultant with an appetite for architecting and implementing scalable software systems, particularly in the realm of web services, user interfaces and cloud technologies. Years of finance industry knowledge particularly in the sectors of payments, fraud detection, prevention and transaction based payment gateway systems.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Architect and implement Java based Micro-services to produce payment technology products. Backend micro service projects utilizing Java, Spring Boot, Rest API creation and consolidation, data modeling, Async communication. RabbitMQ for messaging with JSON payloads. Web sockets for device connection. Gradle and Maven for build files. Unit and integration testing, J-Unit, Mockito, Groovy. Document stores such as MongoDB. Deployment and containerization using Kubernetes, Docker and Gitlab CI/CD environments for scalability. Google cloud platform for storage & scalability. UI Architecture and Implementation utilizing several assorted front end frameworks and tools such as React, Bootstrap, webpack, less, thymeleaf.
